Design & aesthetic:
- Premium editorial-operational mood, match {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}} style and palette.
- Background: Warm ivory (#FAF7F2), panels/rails: Editorial cream (#F5F0E8), inner cards: #FAF7F2, accents: dark goldenrod (#B8860B), hover gold (#D4A017), primary text: near-black (#14110D), secondary text: warm umber (#3A332B), tertiary: muted slate/khaki (#8A7E6E).
- Fonts: Cormorant Garamond / EB Garamond (serif headlines and questions), Hanken Grotesk / Inter (clean sans UI), JetBrains Mono (labels, badges, tracking-widest overlines).
- 1px golden-line subtle borders (e.g. border-[#B8860B]/25 or border-[#B8860B]/30), 12px/16px rounded radii, no emojis, pixel values multiples of 4.

Page Layout & Structure:
1. Top Bar (height 52px / h-14):
   - Left: Mono uppercase overline 'RIG DESIGN STUDIO' in dark goldenrod (#B8860B) with 0.3em letter-spacing. Vertical gold divider line.
   - Serif project title: 'Design a launch page for a Denver HR leaders group' (Cormorant Garamond italic/regular, text-lg).
   - Centered/Right pill nav tabs: ['Board', 'Double Diamond', 'Mockups'], with 'Double Diamond' in active state (solid near-black #14110D background, white/cream text, rounded-full pill). 'Board' and 'Mockups' as inactive styled links/tabs.
   - Action controls: '+ Artifact' button (gold-accented outline pill), 'Reset board', tuning icon, history icon, share icon, and user avatar initials badge ('SA').

2. Double Diamond Banner Section:
   - Clean, wide diagram strip featuring the classic 4-phase Double Diamond vector illustration in thin 1.5px goldenrod (#B8860B) lines:
     - Diamond 1 (Expand/Diverge): DISCOVER
     - Diamond 2 (Contract/Converge): DEFINE
     - Diamond 3 (Expand/Diverge): DEVELOP
     - Diamond 4 (Contract/Converge): DELIVER
   - The diamonds connect seamlessly in a 2-diamond shape pair (Diverge -> Converge, Diverge -> Converge) with delicate SVG lines, labeled in mono uppercase tracking-widest (DISCOVER, DEFINE, DEVELOP, DELIVER), with phase status indicators or active phase highlight.
   - Sub-note line below diamond banner: small mono/sans tertiary text 'Board: Drag cards between phases to re-stage them. Deviation index tracks drift from canonical design tokens.'

3. Four Equal Rails in One Row (14px gap / gap-3.5 or gap-4):
   - Four distinct vertical stage columns fitting side-by-side in the main canvas area (scrollable cards container):
     * Rail 1: DISCOVER · 4 ARTIFACTS
       - Editorial question line: "What is the real human problem?" (italic serif font-serif)
       - Artifact cards:
         • "Leadership Persona Archetypes & Value Drivers" (Synthesis · Approved · dev +2)
         • "Can we name the specific human we intend to help?" (Problem Framing · In-Review · dev 0)
         • "Maya — VP People, 180-person SaaS, Denver" (User Persona · Approved · dev +1)
         • "Field Note: 14 Cohort Stakeholder Interviews" (Discovery · Approved · dev +2)
     * Rail 2: DEFINE · 3 ARTIFACTS
       - Editorial question line: "What exact standard must we meet?"
       - Artifact cards:
         • "HMW make a launch page that feels like Denver HR peers, not a vendor?" (Framing · In-Review · dev +1)
         • "Registration Onboarding & Cohort Screening Funnel" (IA & Flow · In-Review · dev 0)
         • "Denver Executive Salon Positioning Statement" (Strategy · Draft · dev +1)
     * Rail 3: DEVELOP · 4 ARTIFACTS
       - Editorial question line: "How do we express the covenant?"
       - Artifact cards:
         • "Variant B — Light lead-magnet theme" (Visual System · Active · dev +3)
         • "Hero Visual System & Editorial Monograms" (System Assets · Draft · dev +3)
         • "Keynote & Executive Roundtable Curriculum" (Content Strategy · In-Review · dev +1)
         • "Cohort Testimonial & Peer Vouch Grid Component" (UI Spec · Draft · dev 0)
     * Rail 4: DELIVER · 3 ARTIFACTS
       - Editorial question line: "Is it production-ready and true?"
       - Artifact cards:
         • "Dev handoff — launch page build spec (Variant B)" (Handoff · In-Progress · dev 0)
         • "Production Typography & Goldenrod Token Export" (Tokens · Verified · dev 0)
         • "Accessible Contrast & Screen-Reader Verification" (QA Audit · Pending · dev 0)
   - Each card features:
     - Top meta row: Kind badge (mono, tracking-wider), Status dot + label, right-aligned token deviation badge (e.g. dev 0, dev +1, dev +2, dev +3).
     - Serif card title (Cormorant Garamond / EB Garamond medium).
     - Subtle summary snippet or tags.
     - 1px gold border, 12px rounded, hover elevate with warm shadow.

4. Right Side Panel (340px fixed width, matching Screen 1):
   - Docked on the right, cream surface (#F5F0E8), 1px gold border-l.
   - Header: 'RIG TOKEN MANIFEST · v2.4', '64px Grid Active' pill, 'System Inspector', subtext 'Stage view v2.4 · 4 Stages Active'.
   - 4-tab rail: [Artifacts, Tokens, Connect, History] with Artifacts or Stages selected.
   - System Palette: 5 registered tokens (Warm Ivory #FAF7F2, Editorial Cream #F5F0E8, Dark Goldenrod #B8860B, Near Black #14110D, Warm Umber #3A332B).
   - Quick action button: "Apply tokens: light (lead magnets)" in solid near-black.
   - Selected Artifact summary inspection card:
     * ID: ART-014
     * Title: "Leadership Persona Archetypes & Value Drivers"
     * Workstream dropdown: Discovery
     * Status dropdown: Approved
     * Token Deviation Index slider (+2 Spec)
   - Bottom footer: Shortcuts & Documentation links with icons.

Operational Canvas","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system defines an editorial-operational hybrid workspace where the spatial fluidity of an infinite canvas converges with the exacting precision of systematic product architecture. It serves design directors, systems architects, and creative strategists who require an environment that feels less like generic utility software and more like a tailored atelier. 

The aesthetic synthesizes:
- **Literary Editorial Warmth:** High-contrast serif headlines, tactile paper-weight tints, and calibrated reading rhythms.
- **Architectural Tooling:** Structural hairline rules, monospaced metadata, and disciplined planar grouping.
- **Calm Utility:** Deep focus fostered through non-vibrating neutral fields, eliminating software glare while retaining absolute clarity for complex canvas nodes.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace enforces a desktop-first, infinite-canvas layout anchored by a strict 4px grid interval (all spatial increments must resolve to multiples of 4).

- **The Canvas Substrate:** The root infinite workspace is bound to a dynamic 16px/64px dual-scale dot matrix tinted in tertiary umber (`#8A7E6E` at 18% opacity).
- **Chrome Panels:** 
  - The left system tree panel holds a fixed width of `280px`.
  - The right inspector rail occupies a fixed width of `320px`.
  - The floating tool shelf floats `24px` above the bottom screen boundary, auto-centering horizontally.
- **Micro-Spacers:** 
  - Toolbars, token fields, and inline micro-controls use `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px).
  - Component internals and form groups utilize `space-md` (16px).
  - Structural margins between independent tool modules resolve at `space-lg` (24px) or `space-xl` (32px).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects heavy, artificial drop-shadows in favor of tonal stacking, structural hairlines, and ambient edge illumination:

- **Level 0 (Infinite Plane):** `#FAF7F2` flat background with dot matrix. Zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Docked Structural Chrome):** `#F5F0E8` sidebars and tool docks. Delimited by a crisp, continuous `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)` edge rule.
- **Level 2 (Canvas Nodes & Cards):** `#F5F0E8` base with `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`. Supported by a soft, diffused ambient contact shadow: `0 2px 8px -2px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.04), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.02)`.
- **Level 3 (Floating Canvas Palettes, Toolbars):** `#F5F0E8` panel with `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.35)` and an ambient veil: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.08), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.04)`.
- **Level 4 (Modals, Overlays, Context Menus):** `#FFFFFF` surfaces featuring high-contrast definition via `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.40)` and `0 16px 40px -8px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.12)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Background `#B8860B`, label `#FFFFFF` in `Hanken Grotesk` (14px, weight 500), border `1px solid #B8860B`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `#D4A017`, border `#D4A017`. Active state scales subtly to `0.98`.
- **Secondary / Studio:** Background `#F5F0E8`, label `#14110D`, border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `#FAF7F2`, border `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.50)`.
- **Ghost / Minimal:** Background transparent, label `#3A332B`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.08)`, label `#14110D`.

### Canvas Nodes & Cards
- Constructed with `#F5F0E8` fill and a persistent `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)` perimeter.
- Standard modules apply `12px` corner rounding; parent operational clusters and grouped artboards employ `16px`.
- Card headers pair an `EB Garamond` title with trailing technical indicators set in `JetBrains Mono` (`label-md`).

### Form Controls & Inputs
- **Text Inputs:** Background `#FAF7F2`, label in `label-md` (`JetBrains Mono`), body value in `Hanken Grotesk` (14px). Border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`, radius `12px`, padding `8px 12px`. Focused state: border `1px solid #B8860B` with `0 0 0 1px #B8860B`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** Custom `16px` boxes with `4px` radius for checkboxes; `16px` circular discs for radios. Border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.40)`. When checked, filled with `#B8860B` containing a crisp ivory checkmark or dot.

### Chips & Metadata Tags
- Height: `24px`. Radius: `12px`.
- Background: `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.06)`, border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.20)`.
- Typography: `JetBrains Mono` (`label-sm`), color `#3A332B`.

### Lists & Navigation Trees
- Single-line items with `28px` height, `12px` corner rounding on hover (`rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.08)`).
- Selected rows display a subtle left border pip in `#B8860B` with a `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.12)` surface fill.

### Canvas Tool Shelf (Dock)
- Floating toolbar container built on `#F5F0E8` with `16px` radius and `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.35)`.
- Tool buttons utilize square `36x36px` bounding boxes, `12px` internal radius, and mono tooltips displaying matching hotkeys.","theme":{"colorMode":"LIGHT","font":"EB_GARAMOND","roundness":"ROUND_EIGHT","customColor":"#b8860b","headlineFont":"EB_GARAMOND","bodyFont":"HANKEN_GROTESK","labelFont":"JETBRAINS_MONO","namedColors":{"secondary_container":"#ffc641","primary":"#785600","tertiary_container":"#3477bc","secondary":"#795900","inverse_primary":"#f7bd48","on_tertiary_fixed":"#001c37","inverse_on_surface":"#f8efe8","surface_container_low":"#fbf2eb","on_background":"#1e1b17","on_secondary_container":"#715300","surface_tint":"#7b5800","surface_container_lowest":"#ffffff","on_tertiary":"#ffffff","surface_container_highest":"#e9e1da","surface_variant":"#e9e1da","on_error_container":"#93000a","on_surface_variant":"#4f4535","on_secondary_fixed":"#261a00","on_primary":"#ffffff","on_surface":"#1e1b17","error_container":"#ffdad6","on_tertiary_container":"#fdfcff","surface_container_high":"#efe7df","surface_bright":"#fff8f3","on_primary_fixed":"#271900","primary_fixed":"#ffdea6","surface_dim":"#e1d9d1","outline":"#817563","tertiary_fixed":"#d2e4ff","error":"#ba1a1a","on_error":"#ffffff","inverse_surface":"#34302b","outline_variant":"#d3c4af","surface_container":"#f5ece5","surface":"#fff8f3","on_tertiary_fixed_variant":"#004880","tertiary":"#085ea2","on_primary_container":"#fffbff","on_primary_fixed_variant":"#5d4200","tertiary_fixed_dim":"#a1c9ff","background":"#fff8f3","primary_container":"#986d00","on_secondary":"#ffffff","secondary_fixed":"#ffdfa0","secondary_fixed_dim":"#f6be39","primary_fixed_dim":"#f7bd48","on_secondary_fixed_variant":"#5c4300"},"designMd":"---

## Brand & Style

This design system defines an editorial-operational hybrid workspace where the spatial fluidity of an infinite canvas converges with the exacting precision of systematic product architecture. It serves design directors, systems architects, and creative strategists who require an environment that feels less like generic utility software and more like a tailored atelier. 

The aesthetic synthesizes:
- **Literary Editorial Warmth:** High-contrast serif headlines, tactile paper-weight tints, and calibrated reading rhythms.
- **Architectural Tooling:** Structural hairline rules, monospaced metadata, and disciplined planar grouping.
- **Calm Utility:** Deep focus fostered through non-vibrating neutral fields, eliminating software glare while retaining absolute clarity for complex canvas nodes.

## Colors

The palette relies on a tonal stratification of unbleached parchment, hand-pressed paper, and deep iron-gall ink, accented with gilded structural lines.

- **Canvas & Surfaces:**
  - Base Page/Infinite Canvas: `#FAF7F2` (Warm Ivory)
  - Work Surfaces, Panels, Floating Sheets: `#F5F0E8` (Pressed Cream)
  - Inset Inputs, Canvas Tiles, Nested Shelves: `#EFE9DF`
  - High-Elevation Inspector Overlays: `#FFFFFF`
- **Text & Content Tone:**
  - Primary (Headings, Canvas Entities, Active States): `#14110D` (Warm Near-Black)
  - Secondary (Body Copy, Secondary Navigation, Form Labels): `#3A332B` (Deep Espresso)
  - Tertiary (Disabled States, Timestamps, Canvas Grid Dots): `#8A7E6E` (Faded Umber)
- **Accents & Delimiters:**
  - Structural Borders & Hairlines: `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`
  - Active Goldenrod (Selections, Focus Rings, Master Keys): `#B8860B`
  - Radiant Goldenrod (Hover States, Interactive Indicators): `#D4A017`
  - Selection Fill Wash: `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.08)`

## Typography

The typographical hierarchy employs a tripartite structural allocation:

1. **EB Garamond (Editorial Titles):** Delivers authority, literary weight, and editorial balance to major view titles, board names, and modal headlines. Rendered with optical sizing considerations and tighter letter-spacing on larger sizes.
2. **Hanken Grotesk (Operational Interface):** Supplies neutral, low-friction readability for complex canvas navigation, property descriptions, documentation streams, and input fields.
3. **JetBrains Mono (Metadata & Technical Syntax):** Encodes system tokens, coordinates, frame ratios, keyboard accelerators, and data tags with disciplined horizontal cadence.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace enforces a desktop-first, infinite-canvas layout anchored by a strict 4px grid interval (all spatial increments must resolve to multiples of 4).

- **The Canvas Substrate:** The root infinite workspace is bound to a dynamic 16px/64px dual-scale dot matrix tinted in tertiary umber (`#8A7E6E` at 18% opacity).
- **Chrome Panels:** 
  - The left system tree panel holds a fixed width of `280px`.
  - The right inspector rail occupies a fixed width of `320px`.
  - The floating tool shelf floats `24px` above the bottom screen boundary, auto-centering horizontally.
- **Micro-Spacers:** 
  - Toolbars, token fields, and inline micro-controls use `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px).
  - Component internals and form groups utilize `space-md` (16px).
  - Structural margins between independent tool modules resolve at `space-lg` (24px) or `space-xl` (32px).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects heavy, artificial drop-shadows in favor of tonal stacking, structural hairlines, and ambient edge illumination:

- **Level 0 (Infinite Plane):** `#FAF7F2` flat background with dot matrix. Zero elevation.

## Brand & Style

This design system defines an editorial-operational hybrid workspace where the spatial fluidity of an infinite canvas converges with the exacting precision of systematic product architecture. It serves design directors, systems architects, and creative strategists who require an environment that feels less like generic utility software and more like a tailored atelier. 

The aesthetic synthesizes:
- **Literary Editorial Warmth:** High-contrast serif headlines, tactile paper-weight tints, and calibrated reading rhythms.
- **Architectural Tooling:** Structural hairline rules, monospaced metadata, and disciplined planar grouping.
- **Calm Utility:** Deep focus fostered through non-vibrating neutral fields, eliminating software glare while retaining absolute clarity for complex canvas nodes.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace enforces a desktop-first, infinite-canvas layout anchored by a strict 4px grid interval (all spatial increments must resolve to multiples of 4).

- **The Canvas Substrate:** The root infinite workspace is bound to a dynamic 16px/64px dual-scale dot matrix tinted in tertiary umber (`#8A7E6E` at 18% opacity).
- **Chrome Panels:** 
  - The left system tree panel holds a fixed width of `280px`.
  - The right inspector rail occupies a fixed width of `320px`.
  - The floating tool shelf floats `24px` above the bottom screen boundary, auto-centering horizontally.
- **Micro-Spacers:** 
  - Toolbars, token fields, and inline micro-controls use `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px).
  - Component internals and form groups utilize `space-md` (16px).
  - Structural margins between independent tool modules resolve at `space-lg` (24px) or `space-xl` (32px).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects heavy, artificial drop-shadows in favor of tonal stacking, structural hairlines, and ambient edge illumination:

- **Level 0 (Infinite Plane):** `#FAF7F2` flat background with dot matrix. Zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Docked Structural Chrome):** `#F5F0E8` sidebars and tool docks. Delimited by a crisp, continuous `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)` edge rule.

- **Level 4 (Modals, Overlays, Context Menus):** `#FFFFFF` surfaces featuring high-contrast definition via `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.40)` and `0 16px 40px -8px rgba(20, 17, 13, 0.12)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Background `#B8860B`, label `#FFFFFF` in `Hanken Grotesk` (14px, weight 500), border `1px solid #B8860B`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `#D4A017`, border `#D4A017`. Active state scales subtly to `0.98`.
- **Secondary / Studio:** Background `#F5F0E8`, label `#14110D`, border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `#FAF7F2`, border `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.50)`.
- **Ghost / Minimal:** Background transparent, label `#3A332B`, radius `12px`. Hover state: background `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.08)`, label `#14110D`.

### Canvas Nodes & Cards

- Standard modules apply `12px` corner rounding; parent operational clusters and grouped artboards employ `16px`.
- Card headers pair an `EB Garamond` title with trailing technical indicators set in `JetBrains Mono` (`label-md`).

### Form Controls & Inputs
- **Text Inputs:** Background `#FAF7F2`, label in `label-md` (`JetBrains Mono`), body value in `Hanken Grotesk` (14px). Border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.25)`, radius `12px`, padding `8px 12px`. Focused state: border `1px solid #B8860B` with `0 0 0 1px #B8860B`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** Custom `16px` boxes with `4px` radius for checkboxes; `16px` circular discs for radios. Border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.40)`. When checked, filled with `#B8860B` containing a crisp ivory checkmark or dot.

### Chips & Metadata Tags

- Background: `rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.06)`, border `1px solid rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.20)`.
- Typography: `JetBrains Mono` (`label-sm`), color `#3A332B`.

### Lists & Navigation Trees

Screen 2: Double Diamond stage view of RIG Design Studio. Desktop-first 1440x900 viewport.

Design & aesthetic:
- Premium editorial-operational mood, match {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}} style and palette.
- Background: Warm ivory (#FAF7F2), panels/rails: Editorial cream (#F5F0E8), inner cards: #FAF7F2, accents: dark goldenrod (#B8860B), hover gold (#D4A017), primary text: near-black (#14110D), secondary text: warm umber (#3A332B), tertiary: muted slate/khaki (#8A7E6E).
- Fonts: Cormorant Garamond / EB Garamond (serif headlines and questions), Hanken Grotesk / Inter (clean sans UI), JetBrains Mono (labels, badges, tracking-widest overlines).
- 1px golden-line subtle borders (e.g. border-[#B8860B]/25 or border-[#B8860B]/30), 12px/16px rounded radii, no emojis, pixel values multiples of 4.

1. Top Bar (height 52px / h-14):
   - Left: Mono uppercase overline 'RIG DESIGN STUDIO' in dark goldenrod (#B8860B) with 0.3em letter-spacing. Vertical gold divider line.

   - Centered/Right pill nav tabs: ['Board', 'Double Diamond', 'Mockups'], with 'Double Diamond' in active state (solid near-black #14110D background, white/cream text, rounded-full pill). 'Board' and 'Mockups' as inactive styled links/tabs.
   - Action controls: '+ Artifact' button (gold-accented outline pill), 'Reset board', tuning icon, history icon, share icon, and user avatar initials badge ('SA').

2. Double Diamond Banner Section:
   - Clean, wide diagram strip featuring the classic 4-phase Double Diamond vector illustration in thin 1.5px goldenrod (#B8860B) lines:
